# Mutants for `__filename` and `__dirname` (#redxes2)

The ruling (docs/rulings.md, Nov 6) owes three mutants: `__filename` bound to the working directory, the declaration ignored, and a `.a` file binding in a build that declares one bundled image (`--module-format commonjs-bundle`, `lower.ModuleFormatCommonJSBundle`; Adamic's ruling on #0ta3dk9 named it so). They are recorded here together, with a fourth for Runtime's question on npm's link: `__filename` as the path tsc was invoked by, not the image it resolves to. None has been run yet: each is to be run on the test box against the tests it names, and this record is to say what it saw.

The installed-layout harness is internal/oracle/installed_layout_test.go: TestInstalledLayoutReadsAreNodes runs tsc_reads, a program of two modules in two directories (main.ts, and the reads in sys/sys.ts), on Node, each module transpiled to CommonJS by TypeScript 6.0.3's transpileModule and wrapped into one bundle, `node_modules/typescript/lib/_tsc.js`, as tsc ships (testdata/installed_layout/transpile.cjs, no bundler), and built natively under `lower.ModuleFormatCommonJSBundle` as one image, `node_modules/typescript/lib/_tsc`, each from internal/oracle, outside lib, beside `lib.d.ts`, `lib.es2020.d.ts` and `ja/diagnosticMessages.generated.json`. It compares their output byte for byte and pins Node's lines. The two lowering mutants' tests are in internal/lower/library_node_commonjs_test.go.

| Mutant | Edit | Red |
|---|---|---|
| (1) `__filename` bound to the working directory | internal/oracle/installed_layout_test.go, `installedLayoutCwdMutant`: the program's `adamic_node_filename()` and `adamic_node_dirname()` replaced by functions answering `<cwd>/_tsc` and `<cwd>` (`adamic_host_cwd`), defined after the C's includes, so lowering and the runtime archive are unchanged. The edit is planted by the test itself | TestInstalledLayoutCwdMutantMovesTheReads holds that the mutant's directory, `lib.d.ts`, locale and `lib.es2020.d.ts` lines all differ from Node's (`directory oracle`, `lib.d.ts false`, `locale missing`, `lib.es2020.d.ts false` where Node prints `directory lib`, `lib.d.ts true`, the locale's JSON and `lib.es2020.d.ts true`), so TestInstalledLayoutReadsAreNodes's comparison goes red on those four. The case probe isn't held: on a case-sensitive file system it agrees |
| (2) The declaration ignored | internal/lower/library_node_commonjs.go, `nodeCommonJSModuleValuesBound`: `l.moduleFormat == ModuleFormatCommonJSBundle && ` removed | TestNodeCommonJSNamesItsReasons/filename and /dirname, and TestNodeCommonJSSiteCountsOnce/filename and /dirname: the `.ts` reads under Lower's default lower, or count no site. TestNodeCommonJSModuleValuesBindInATSFileOfABundle, both rows: declared an ES module, the read lowers |
| (3) A `.a` file binding in a bundled image | internal/lower/library_node_commonjs.go, `nodeCommonJSModuleValuesBound`: the suffix `".ts"` in its `strings.HasSuffix` check replaced by `""`, so every file passes it (removing the check outright leaves `strings` unused, and a mutant that doesn't compile catches nothing) | TestNodeCommonJSModuleValuesStayNotYetInAnAFile, both rows: testdata/commonjs_reasons/filename.a and dirname.a lower |
| (4) `__filename` as the invoked path, not the resolved image | internal/oracle/installed_layout_test.go, `installedLayoutInvokedMutant`: `adamic_node_filename()` and `adamic_node_dirname()` replaced by functions answering argv[0], the first string of `/proc/self/cmdline`, and its directory (`adamic_node_path_dirname`), planted in the generated C as (1) is. The test runs both legs through `node_modules/.bin/tsc`, a link to the entry, by its absolute path | TestInstalledLayoutInvokedPathMutantMovesTheReads holds that the mutant's directory, `lib.d.ts`, locale and `lib.es2020.d.ts` lines all differ from Node's (`directory .bin`, `lib.d.ts false`, `locale missing`, `lib.es2020.d.ts false` where Node, resolving the link, prints the pinned lines), so TestInstalledLayoutReadsThroughTheLinkAreNodes's comparison goes red on those four. Linux only: it reads `/proc` |

Native's resolution through the link is by reading on darwin: `capture_executable_identity` realpaths `_NSGetExecutablePath`'s answer (internal/native/runtime/host_runtime.c:207-209), as Linux's `/proc/self/exe` is resolved by the kernel. TestInstalledLayoutReadsThroughTheLinkAreNodes is owed a darwin run.

The ruling's harness rows not built here: `--listFiles`, which mutant (1) would also turn red, and `--generateCpuProfile`'s relativized URLs or its named stop. Each needs tsc's own reads of them, beyond tsc_reads.
